data.name: CannotDeleteFirst
data.value: This connection cannot empty a table and import into it in one transaction, so it cannot delete the existing rows first.

data.name: CannotMatchRows
data.value: This connection cannot match imported rows against existing ones.

data.name: ChooseMatchKey
data.value: Choose the key the rows are matched on.

data.name: ColumnMappedTwice
data.value: Each column can be mapped from only one field.

data.name: CouldNotReadExistingRows
data.value: Could not read which rows are already in the table.

data.name: DeleteFirstCannotMatch
data.value: Delete existing rows first empties the table, so no row would match. Turn it off, or import as Insert.

data.name: IncludedColumnNeedsName
data.value: Every included column needs a name.

data.name: IncludedColumnNeedsType
data.value: Every included column needs a type.

data.name: KeyMatchedSeveralRows
data.value: The key {0} matched {1} rows, so the row was not written.
data.comment: {0} lists the key, such as id = 7; {1} is a row count, always more than one.

data.name: KeyNeedsValuePerColumn
data.value: Every key needs one value per key column.

data.name: KeyValueMissing
data.value: This row has no value for the key column {0}, so it cannot be matched.

data.name: MapAtLeastOneField
data.value: Map at least one field to a column.

data.name: NoFieldMapped
data.value: No field in the file is mapped to a column of this table.

data.name: RollbackAlsoFailed
data.comment: {0} is the database's error message for the failed rollback.

data.name: ScriptErrorLine
data.comment: {0} is a line number, {1} the database's error message.

data.name: SqlFileIsScript
data.value: A SQL file is run as a script, not read as rows.
